Container.Name: everylist
Container.Overview: EveryList is a narrowed, mobile-first, offline-capable shopping/task list PWA - a leaner alternative to AnyList. Create lists, share them in real time with your household, auto-categorize items by store aisle, and keep working with zero connectivity - it syncs when you're back online. Data is stored locally in SQLite under the appdata path, so backups are just a folder copy.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the EveryList web UI and API are served on

Config.Name: Appdata Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and (Phase 5) uploaded item photos

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as inside the container. Matches Unraid's 'nobody' user by default - set to match the owner of your appdata share

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as inside the container. Matches Unraid's 'users' group by default - set to match the owner of your appdata share

Config.Name: APP_KEY
Config.Description: AdonisJS application encryption/signing key. Optional - if left blank, the container generates one on first boot and persists it to /config/app_key, so it survives restarts/updates. Set this only if you want to pin a specific key (e.g. restoring onto a fresh /config) or rotate an existing one

Config.Name: HOST
Config.Description: Interface the server binds to inside the container. Leave as default unless you know you need to change it

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal port the app listens on. Must match the container port set in WebUI Port above

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Node environment the app runs in
